responsibility: Defines the per-body `FnCtxt` state used during type checking, including the body-local parameter environment, return coercion state, divergence tracking, breakable-context stack, and its `AstConv` integration for creating and resolving inference-based types within a function body.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the parent `check/mod.rs`, which assembles the whole checking phase, this `mod.rs` is scoped to the per-body `FnCtxt` engine and its `AstConv` implementation used while type-checking a single function or closure body.
